I understand that the master builder is currently unavailable, but I must insist that these issues be rectified immediately. The music room of the Imperial Court cannot afford to have a subpar instrument tarnishing the performances of our esteemed musicians. I trust that you will take this matter seriously and ensure that the necessary repairs are carried out promptly.
